scope: Read-only non-blinded visual verification of eight proposed guided-photo gallery examples. All eight exact JPEGs were viewed with tools.view_image. An additional roulette discriminator JPEG was also viewed. No semantic ground truth inferred from credit titles.
overall: No official caption/ID mixup or unsupported claim in any selected evidence[0] alt line. All eight local JPEG hashes match the manifest and their held-out paths match the review bundle.

cases.literal_alt: A seated man is prominently framed, with his lips on a trumpet mouthpiece and his hands holding and operating the instrument.
cases.visible_check: A seated musician visibly has a trumpet mouthpiece at his lips, with both hands around the instrument; saxophones frame him.
cases.finding: No visual mismatch or overconfident identity. The first evidence line is a safe literal alt. The source title does not establish a person identity.

cases.literal_alt: The photograph centers on a copper-wire coil connected to colored leads and alligator clips.
cases.visible_check: An exposed copper-wire coil, colored wires and alligator clips, small circuit components, and an earpiece-like component lie on fabric.
cases.finding: The first evidence line is safe and directly visible. Minor wording caution in the explanation: homemade infers manufacturing provenance. Exposed electronic assembly is more strictly visual. Crystal radio is a source title, not a function conclusively established from this image alone.
cases.source_title_provenance_only: Crystal Radio / ゲルマニウムラジオ完成図

cases.literal_alt: The photograph is an extreme close-up of pale yellow and cream rounded, lobed forms, some with raised granular centers.
cases.visible_check: Pale yellow or cream translucent rounded lobes and irregular granular clusters fill a macro crop without a scale cue or culinary setting.
cases.finding: The first evidence line and explicit uncertainty accurately avoid identifying the substance. Do not replace the neutral description with ice, drink, kefir, food granules, or another asserted identity from the source title.

cases.literal_alt: Illuminated arched openings, upper-story windows, railings, and a large masonry column establish a courtyard-like architectural setting.
cases.visible_check: Dense foreground foliage, trunks and fronds partially obscure illuminated arches, windows, rails, chairs, a person, and a large right-hand column.
cases.finding: The first evidence line is factually supported; courtyard-like is appropriately qualified. It emphasizes architecture and omits the prominent plants, so it should not be presented as proving the winning category. The full official review already preserves the competing vegetation reading.

cases.literal_alt: The photograph centers on a cooking installation with recessed burner openings, metal pot supports, gas hoses, and a shutoff valve.
cases.visible_check: A brick-and-mortar cooking installation has recessed openings, metal pot supports or burners, tubing, and red-handled valves.
cases.finding: The first evidence line is supported. Gas cooking apparatus is a reasonable visible interpretation; biogas specifically is not visually verifiable and should remain a source-title claim. The official both-reasonable treatment preserves equipment versus structure ambiguity.

cases.literal_alt: The photograph centers on a natural cavern with irregular rock walls, a rocky ceiling, and numerous stalactites and mineral formations.
cases.visible_check: An artificially lit cavern contains irregular rock walls, a low rocky ceiling, stalactites, and other mineral formations; a small sign is peripheral.
cases.finding: The first evidence line and official geological-subject explanation match the image. The exact cave name and visit date belong only in source credit.

cases.literal_alt: Two large pink flowers dominate the foreground, with green buds, stems, and leaves visible behind them.
cases.visible_check: Two large pink blossoms dominate the image, with buds, stems, and green leaves around them.
cases.finding: The first evidence line is accurate and does not overclaim species. No shared label or caption error is apparent.

cases.literal_alt: A rigid, vented protective helmet occupies most of the photograph; no wearer is visible.
cases.visible_check: A rigid vented helmet fills an overhead object photograph. A mounting plate is centered on its shell and a tethered compact camera is at its right side. No wearer appears.
cases.finding: The first evidence line is accurate and avoids brand claims. The official unclear judgment is appropriately about catalog treatment, not object recognizability. Keep this distinct from item 5bf3e3ec2042ff390633, which is a roulette-table photograph.

discriminator.visible_subject: Roulette table with numbered green betting layout, padded edge, wheel and chips inside a room. This is not the helmet photograph.
